law.text:
In ascertaining the value of the assets of a credit union:
A loan delinquent for more than two but less than six months shall be valued at 90 percent of the unpaid balance;
A loan delinquent for six months but less than 12 months shall be valued at 75 percent of the unpaid balance; and
A loan delinquent for 12 months or more shall be treated as of no value.
